comparison.objective: Open a bench gas tap and spark-light a Bunsen burner, then return the striker safely; candidate mechanically adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests timed bimanual coordination of tap rotation, striker placement near a burner mouth, squeezing to spark, and tool return. Candidate tests hex-bit alignment, captive unlocking, fine collar rotation, counterholding, torque-limited relocking, and repeated physical-cycle assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires ignition with ≤1.5 s cumulative unlit gas, adequate tap opening, striker replacement, retreat, and no drop or hot-barrel contact. Candidate requires two acceptable energy-absorption cycles and retained adjustment without bottoming, hard-stop contact, overload, or excessive rebound.
comparison.reason: Timed ignition and gas-safety handling do not exercise mechanical tuning or lock-retention under repeated impacts. Shared control rotation, tool use, and bimanual timing are generic.
